title: Realtime-Bench: Can Frontier Models Solve Real-time Interactive Problems?
title_zh: Realtime-Bench：前沿模型能否解决实时互动问题？

paragraphs.en: Real-time interaction requires agents to perceive evolving environments and act under temporal constraints, yet existing evaluations of real-time streaming models focus on conversational quality and streaming perception, leaving effective action under strict temporal constraints untested. We introduce Realtime-Bench, a suite of carefully curated dynamic tasks where delayed actions directly affect success. Under Wall Clock, where environments advance according to actual inference latency, the best success rate reaches only 44% and the best Pass^3 is only 36%, demonstrating that real-time interaction remains challenging. To separate serving latency from models’ real-time streaming capability, we compare Wall Clock with Paused Clock, which removes inference delays as an idealized reference, and introduce Token Clock, which advances simulated time according to generated token counts, testing temporal awareness independently of physical serving speed. We find that temporal costs limit success in evolving environments and that higher reasoning effort has mixed effects under time pressure, reflecting a trade-off between decision quality and timely execution. These findings suggest directions for improving real-time multimodal agents, including adaptive reasoning with temporal awareness and continuous perception and action.

paragraphs.en: Many real-world interactive scenarios require decisions to be made under strict temporal constraints. For example, when purchasing a highly demanded ticket, detecting availability is not enough: an agent must observe the changing interface and act before the opportunity disappears. Such scenarios require real-time streaming capabilities , where a model continuously perceives an evolving environment and produces timely actions in response to newly arriving information. Recently, a growing family of real-time streaming models, such as GPT-Realtime ( OpenAI, 2025 ) and Gemini Live ( Google, 2026b ) , has begun to make this setting practically possible. In contrast to asynchronous models that process inputs only after they are fully received, these models can consume streaming inputs and react to new information with low latency.
paragraphs.zh: 许多现实世界中的交互场景都要求在严格的时间限制下做出决策。 例如，在抢购需求极高的门票时，仅仅检测到库存可用是不够的：智能体必须观察不断变化的界面，并在机会消失之前采取行动。 这类场景需要实时流式处理能力，即模型能够持续感知不断变化的环境，并根据新到的信息及时做出反应。 最近，一系列日益成熟的实时流式模型（如 GPT-Realtime（OpenAI，2025）和 Gemini Live（Google，2026b））开始使这种设定在实践上成为可能。 与那些只有在输入完全接收后才会处理的异步模型不同，这些模型能够处理流式输入，并以低延迟对新信息做出反应。

paragraphs.en: Unlike previous benchmarks that evaluate models in static environments ( Zhang et al., 2026 ; Tan et al., 2026 ) where the environment does not continuously evolve, evaluating streaming models requires dynamic settings that test whether models can perceive and act effectively under strict temporal constraints. However, existing evaluations of real-time systems largely focus on capabilities such as streaming perception, conversational quality, and interruption handling ( Lin et al., 2026 ; Lu et al., 2026b ) , with limited coverage of interactive tasks in which actions affect subsequent environment states and delayed execution can change the outcome.
paragraphs.zh: 与在静态环境中评估模型的传统基准测试（Zhang 等人，2026；Tan 等人，2026）不同——在这些测试中环境不会持续演变——流式模型需要动态的评估设置，以检验模型是否能在严格的时间限制下有效感知并执行操作。 然而，现有对实时系统的评估主要关注流式感知、对话质量和中断处理等能力（Lin 等人，2026；Lu 等人，2026b），而对那些操作会影响后续环境状态且延迟执行可能改变结果的交互任务，则覆盖有限。

paragraphs.en: We first characterize real-time streaming capability along three complementary dimensions: temporal state awareness, adaptive deliberation, and time-aware action selection. These dimensions capture an agent’s ability to track relevant changes and information freshness, adjust deliberation to the available time, and select actions that remain useful when executed. Building on this framework, we introduce Realtime-Bench , comprising 50 interactive game and web tasks in which evolving states and limited opportunities make success depend on both action choice and timing.
paragraphs.zh: 我们首先从三个相互补充的维度来描述实时流式处理能力：时间状态感知、自适应推理以及时间感知的动作选择。 这些维度体现了智能体追踪相关变化与信息新鲜度的能力，能够根据可用时间调整推理过程，并选择在执行时仍具有实用价值的动作。 基于这一框架，我们提出了 Realtime-Bench，它包含 50 个交互式游戏和网页任务，在这些任务中，不断变化的状态和有限的机会使得成功既取决于动作的选择，也取决于执行时机。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate 12 frontier models spanning standard asynchronous models, streaming models and decision models. As shown in Figure 1 , real-time interaction remains challenging, with the best success rate reaching only 44.0% and best pass^3 is below 37% under Wall Clock , which advances the environment according to actual inference and serving time, following prior interactive-agent evaluations ( Kang et al., 2025 ; Froger et al., 2026 ; ValsAI, 2026 ; Parekh et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 我们评估了 12 款前沿模型，涵盖标准异步模型、流式模型和决策模型。 如图 1 所示，实时交互仍然充满挑战：在 Wall Clock（根据实际推理和服务时间推进环境）环境下，最佳成功率仅为 44.0%，最佳通过率^3 甚至低于 37%；这一结果延续了此前对交互式智能体的评估研究（Kang et al., 2025; Froger et al., 2026; ValsAI, 2026; Parekh et al., 2026）。

sents.en: As shown in Figure 1 , real-time interaction remains challenging, with the best success rate reaching only 44.0% and best pass^3 is below 37% under Wall Clock , which advances the environment according to actual inference and serving time, following prior interactive-agent evaluations ( Kang et al., 2025 ; Froger et al., 2026 ; ValsAI, 2026 ; Parekh et al., 2026 ) .

paragraphs.en: To better understand these limitations and disentangle the effects of serving latency and models’ real-time streaming capability, we compare three clock protocols (Figure 2 ). Alongside Wall Clock, Paused Clock freezes the environment during inference, providing an idealized reference in which deliberation incurs no temporal cost ( Tan et al., 2026 ; Zheng et al., 2026 ; Tan et al., 2025 ) . We further introduce Token Clock , which advances simulated time according to the number of generation tokens consumed before an action is committed. Models that spend more tokens deliberating therefore act later, preserving the task consequences of delayed decisions while controlling for physical serving speed. Under each clock, we test low and high reasoning effort to examine the trade-off between decision quality and timely execution. Our analysis reveals that substantial performance gaps relative to Paused Clock persist under Token Clock, highlighting the difficulty of translating task competence into timely action even when temporal costs are standardized independently of serving speed. Higher reasoning effort improves success for all six models under Paused Clock but has mixed effects under temporal pressure. Further experiments show that relaxing the temporal cost of generation generally improves performance but does not ensure task success. These findings motivate future work on adaptive reasoning with temporal awareness and continuous perception and action, enabling agents to coordinate deliberation and execution with the time available.
paragraphs.zh: 为了更好地理解这些局限性，并区分服务延迟与模型实时流式处理能力的各自影响，我们比较了三种时钟协议（图2）。 除了“墙钟”之外，“暂停钟”在推理过程中冻结环境，提供了一个理想化的参考场景：在此场景中，审慎思考不会产生任何时间成本（Tan et al., 2026；Zheng et al., 2026；Tan et al., 2025）。 我们进一步引入了“令牌钟”，它根据执行动作前所消耗的生成令牌数量来推进模拟时间。 因此，消耗更多令牌进行审慎思考的模型会延迟行动，从而在控制实际服务速度的同时，保留了延迟决策所带来的任务后果。 在每种时钟机制下，我们都测试了低推理努力与高推理努力两种情况，以考察决策质量与及时执行之间的权衡关系。 我们的分析表明，即使在“令牌钟”机制下，“暂停钟”所表现出的显著性能差距依然存在，这凸显出即便时间成本已独立于服务速度进行标准化，将任务能力转化为及时行动仍然十分困难。 在“暂停钟”机制下，更高的推理努力提升了全部六个模型的成功率，但在存在时间压力的情况下，其效果则参差不齐。 进一步实验表明，降低生成过程的时间成本通常能提升性能，但并不能保证任务成功。 这些发现为未来研究提供了方向：开发具备时间感知能力的自适应推理机制，以及实现持续感知与行动的能力，使智能体能够根据可用时间来协调审慎思考与执行操作。

paragraphs.en: Video multimodal models have progressively evolved from offline video understanding ( Maaz et al., 2024 ; Lin et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2024b ; Liu et al., 2024a ; Liu et al., 2023 ) toward real-time streaming interaction, where models continuously perceive incoming observations and decide when and how to respond as the stream unfolds ( Chen et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2025b ; Qian et al., 2025 ; Cui et al., 2026 ) . Existing training and evaluation formulate real-time interaction as responding to a continuously arriving but sparsely sampled audiovisual stream, commonly at around 1–2 FPS ( Chen et al., 2024 ; Qian et al., 2025 ; Yan et al., 2026 ; Lu et al., 2026b ) . Under this setting, existing benchmarks focus on evaluating the abilities of streaming perception ( Lin et al., 2026 ; Huang et al., 2025 ; Shi et al., 2026 ) , response timing ( Wang et al., 2025a ; He et al., 2026 ; Lu et al., 2026b ) , interruption handling ( Lin et al., 2025 ; Lu et al., 2026b ) , and conversational quality ( He et al., 2026 ; Lu et al., 2026b ) in scenarios such as surveillance anomaly detection ( Wang et al., 2025a ) , question answering during gym exercises and shopping, and step-by-step task guidance ( Lu et al., 2026b ) , leaving untested whether models can act effectively in closed-loop environments where the timing of their decisions affects subsequent states and task outcomes. In contrast, Realtime-Bench evaluates closed-loop interaction in web environments and games, where task success depends on both what actions models take and when they take them.
paragraphs.zh: 视频多模态模型已逐步从离线视频理解（Maaz et al., 2024；Lin et al., 2024；Liu et al., 2024b；Liu et al., 2024a；Liu et al., 2023）演进到实时流式交互，即模型在流数据持续传入时不断感知输入观察结果，并决定何时以及如何做出响应（Chen et al., 2024；Wang et al., 2025b；Qian et al., 2025；Cui et al., 2026）。 现有的训练与评估方法将实时交互定义为对持续传入但采样稀疏的视听流做出响应，其帧率通常在 1–2 FPS 左右（Chen et al., 2024；Qian et al., 2025；Yan et al., 2026；Lu et al., 2026b）。 在此设定下，现有基准测试主要关注评估模型在流式感知（Lin et al., 2026；Huang et al., 2025；Shi et al., 2026）、响应时机（Wang et al., 2025a；He et al., 2026；Lu et al., 2026b）、中断处理（Lin et al., 2025；Lu et al., 2026b）以及对话质量（He et al., 2026；Lu et al., 2026b）方面的能力，应用场景包括监控异常检测（Wang et al., 2025a）、健身锻炼和购物过程中的问答，以及分步任务指导（Lu et al., 2026b），但模型能否在闭环环境中有效行动仍未得到验证——在这些环境中，决策时机会影响后续状态与任务结果。 相比之下，Realtime-Bench 评估的是网页环境与游戏中的闭环交互，其中任务成功既取决于模型采取的行动内容，也取决于其行动时机。

sents.en: Video multimodal models have progressively evolved from offline video understanding ( Maaz et al., 2024 ; Lin et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2024b ; Liu et al., 2024a ; Liu et al., 2023 ) toward real-time streaming interaction, where models continuously perceive incoming observations and decide when and how to respond as the stream unfolds ( Chen et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2025b ; Qian et al., 2025 ; Cui et al., 2026 ) .
sents.zh: 视频多模态模型已逐步从离线视频理解（Maaz et al., 2024；Lin et al., 2024；Liu et al., 2024b；Liu et al., 2024a；Liu et al., 2023）演进到实时流式交互，即模型在流数据持续传入时不断感知输入观察结果，并决定何时以及如何做出响应（Chen et al., 2024；Wang et al., 2025b；Qian et al., 2025；Cui et al., 2026）。

sents.en: Existing training and evaluation formulate real-time interaction as responding to a continuously arriving but sparsely sampled audiovisual stream, commonly at around 1–2 FPS ( Chen et al., 2024 ; Qian et al., 2025 ; Yan et al., 2026 ; Lu et al., 2026b ) .
sents.zh: 现有的训练与评估方法将实时交互定义为对持续传入但采样稀疏的视听流做出响应，其帧率通常在 1–2 FPS 左右（Chen et al., 2024；Qian et al., 2025；Yan et al., 2026；Lu et al., 2026b）。

sents.en: Under this setting, existing benchmarks focus on evaluating the abilities of streaming perception ( Lin et al., 2026 ; Huang et al., 2025 ; Shi et al., 2026 ) , response timing ( Wang et al., 2025a ; He et al., 2026 ; Lu et al., 2026b ) , interruption handling ( Lin et al., 2025 ; Lu et al., 2026b ) , and conversational quality ( He et al., 2026 ; Lu et al., 2026b ) in scenarios such as surveillance anomaly detection ( Wang et al., 2025a ) , question answering during gym exercises and shopping, and step-by-step task guidance ( Lu et al., 2026b ) , leaving untested whether models can act effectively in closed-loop environments where the timing of their decisions affects subsequent states and task outcomes.
sents.zh: 在此设定下，现有基准测试主要关注评估模型在流式感知（Lin et al., 2026；Huang et al., 2025；Shi et al., 2026）、响应时机（Wang et al., 2025a；He et al., 2026；Lu et al., 2026b）、中断处理（Lin et al., 2025；Lu et al., 2026b）以及对话质量（He et al., 2026；Lu et al., 2026b）方面的能力，应用场景包括监控异常检测（Wang et al., 2025a）、健身锻炼和购物过程中的问答，以及分步任务指导（Lu et al., 2026b），但模型能否在闭环环境中有效行动仍未得到验证——在这些环境中，决策时机会影响后续状态与任务结果。

sents.en: In contrast, Realtime-Bench evaluates closed-loop interaction in web environments and games, where task success depends on both what actions models take and when they take them.
sents.zh: 相比之下，Realtime-Bench 评估的是网页环境与游戏中的闭环交互，其中任务成功既取决于模型采取的行动内容，也取决于其行动时机。

paragraphs.en: Existing interactive evaluations assess asynchronous vision-language agents in games that pause during model inference, allowing their perception, reasoning, and planning abilities to be evaluated independently of response speed ( Tan et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ; Tan et al., 2026 ; Zheng et al., 2026 ; Ouyang et al., 2026 ) . To evaluate agents under real-time pressure, VideoGameBench ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) , GameWorld-RT ( Ouyang et al., 2026 ) , GPTNT ( Parekh et al., 2026 ) , and Gaia2 ( Froger et al., 2026 ) allow game or web environments to continue evolving during inference, making task success depend on both decision quality and wall-clock latency. Although such wall-clock capture the consequences of slow responses, they also tie evaluation to deployment-specific inference speed. Similar to Real-Time Reasoning Gym ( Wen et al., 2026 ) , we adopt Token Clock, which maps generated tokens to environment time at a shared rate, preserving the temporal cost of deliberation while decoupling evaluation from physical serving speed.
paragraphs.zh: 现有的交互式评估方法针对异步视觉-语言智能体，在模型推理期间暂停的游戏环境中进行测试，从而能够独立于响应速度来评估其感知、推理和规划能力（Tan et al., 2025；Zhang et al., 2026；Tan et al., 2026；Zheng et al., 2026；Ouyang et al., 2026）。 为了在实时压力下评估智能体，VideoGameBench（Zhang et al., 2026）、GameWorld-RT（Ouyang et al., 2026）、GPTNT（Parekh et al., 2026）和 Gaia2（Froger et al., 2026）允许游戏或网络环境在推理过程中持续演化，使得任务成功既取决于决策质量，也取决于实际运行时的延迟。 尽管这种对实际运行时间的捕捉能够反映缓慢响应的后果，但同时也将评估结果与部署时特定的推理速度绑定在一起。 与 Real-Time Reasoning Gym（Wen et al., 2026）类似，我们采用了 Token Clock 方法，该方法以统一速率将生成的词元映射到环境时间，既保留了审慎思考的时间成本，又将评估与实际服务速度解耦。

paragraphs.en: We define real-time streaming capability as the ability to perceive, reason, and act effectively while the environment continues to evolve. We characterize this capability along three complementary dimensions. (1) Temporal state awareness (RT-Perceive) requires models to use available observations to track relevant changes, information freshness, and opportunity timing; (2) Adaptive deliberation (RT-Deliberate) requires models to adjust their reasoning length and depth according to the available time and the expected benefit of further computation; (3) Time-aware action selection (RT-Act) requires models to determine which action will remain useful when executed, including whether to wait or act immediately and what action to take.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将实时流式处理能力定义为在环境持续演变时，仍能有效感知、推理和行动的能力。 我们从三个相互补充的维度来描述这种能力。 (1) 时间状态感知（RT-Perceive）要求模型利用可用观察信息来追踪相关变化、信息新鲜度和时机；(2) 自适应决策（RT-Deliberate）要求模型根据可用时间和进一步计算的预期收益，调整推理的长度和深度；(3) 时间感知的行动选择（RT-Act）要求模型判断执行哪项行动仍会有效，包括是否等待或立即行动，以及应采取何种行动。

paragraphs.en: These dimensions jointly shape how an agent responds to an evolving environment. For example, an agent purchasing a ticket must track the sale status and assess whether observed availability is still current (RT-Perceive) , limit further deliberation when the purchase window is closing (RT-Deliberate) , and choose between waiting for sales to open and purchasing while tickets remain available (RT-Act) .
paragraphs.zh: 这些维度共同塑造了智能体对不断变化的环境的响应方式。 例如，购买门票的智能体必须追踪销售状态，并评估所观察到的余票信息是否仍然有效（RT-Perceive）；在购票窗口即将关闭时限制进一步的思考（RT-Deliberate）；以及在等待售票窗口重新开放与趁余票尚存时立即购买之间做出选择（RT-Act）。

paragraphs.en: Wall Clock. To evaluate performance under real-world inference latency, Wall Clock advances the environment according to the actual time spent on inference. The environment continues to evolve while the model generates a response, so action timing depends on both model computation and serving infrastructure.

paragraphs.en: To evaluate models’ real-time streaming capabilities in environments that continue to evolve while they observe, reason, and act, we design tasks around the following three criteria.
paragraphs.zh: 为了评估模型在持续变化的环境中，于观察、推理和行动过程中的实时流式处理能力，我们围绕以下三个标准设计了任务。

paragraphs.en: Real-world fidelity. To capture practical real-time interaction demands, task interfaces and interaction mechanics should reflect realistic applications and games. For example, web tasks simulate real-world websites such as Amazon, while game tasks feature popular games.
paragraphs.zh: 真实世界的保真度。 为了捕捉实际实时交互的需求，任务界面和交互机制应反映真实的应用程序和游戏。 例如，网络任务模拟了亚马逊等真实世界的网站，而游戏任务则包含了热门游戏。

sents.en: Real-world fidelity.
sents.zh: 真实世界的保真度。

sents.en: To capture practical real-time interaction demands, task interfaces and interaction mechanics should reflect realistic applications and games.
sents.zh: 为了捕捉实际实时交互的需求，任务界面和交互机制应反映真实的应用程序和游戏。

sents.en: For example, web tasks simulate real-world websites such as Amazon, while game tasks feature popular games.
sents.zh: 例如，网络任务模拟了亚马逊等真实世界的网站，而游戏任务则包含了热门游戏。

paragraphs.en: Dynamically evolving environment. Environment states should change over time, independently of the model’s actions. These changes may include moving game elements, changing availability, or continuously updated information. For example, available seats change during cinema booking, while obstacles move across the screen in games.
paragraphs.zh: 动态变化的环境。 环境状态应随时间变化，且独立于模型的行为。 这些变化可能包括游戏元素的移动、可用性的改变或信息的持续更新。 例如，在影院订票时可用座位会发生变化，而游戏中的障碍物则会在屏幕上移动。

paragraphs.en: To minimize harness-induced overhead when evaluating models’ real-time capabilities, we follow Qwen-CUA ( Lu et al., 2026a ) in removing older history in blocks rather than at every step. This keeps the history prefix unchanged between folds, allowing models to reuse its KV cache across consecutive steps and reducing repeated prefill computation caused by frequent history truncation. All models follow the same history retention policy. Implementation details are provided in Appendix A.3 .
paragraphs.zh: 为在评估模型实时能力时最小化由 harness 引起的额外开销，我们遵循 Qwen-CUA（Lu et al., 2026a）的做法，按块移除旧的历史记录，而非在每一步都进行移除。 这样可以在不同折叠之间保持历史前缀不变，使模型能够在连续步骤中重复使用其 KV 缓存，并减少因频繁截断历史记录而导致的重复预填充计算。 所有模型均遵循相同的历史记录保留策略。 实现细节见附录 A.3。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate 12 frontier models spanning (1) standard asynchronous models, including GPT-6-Astra ( OpenAI, 2026b ) , GPT-5.6 Sol ( OpenAI, 2026c ) , Claude Fable 5.1 ( Anthropic, 2026a ) , Claude Opus 5 ( Anthropic, 2026b ) , Gemini 3.8 Flash ( Google, 2026a ) , Deepseek V4.1 Flash ( Deepseek, 2026 ) and Kimi-K3 ( Team et al., 2026 ) ; (2) real-time streaming models, which are optimized for low-latency interaction, including GPT-Realtime-2 ( OpenAI, 2025 ) , Gemini 3.1 Flash live ( Gemini, 2026 ) and Gemini 3.8 Live ( Google, 2026c ) ; and (3) decision models, which directly return structured decisions rather than generate free-form text, including OpenAI Decisions ( OpenAI, 2026a ) and Jev 1.13 ( TypeSafe, 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 我们评估了 12 款前沿模型，涵盖以下三类：（1）标准异步模型，包括 GPT-6-Astra（OpenAI，2026b）、GPT-5.6 Sol（OpenAI，2026c）、Claude Fable 5.1（Anthropic，2026a）、Claude Opus 5（Anthropic，2026b）、Gemini 3.8 Flash（Google，2026a）、Deepseek V4.1 Flash（Deepseek，2026）和 Kimi-K3（Team et al.，2026）；（2）实时流式模型，这些模型针对低延迟交互进行了优化，包括 GPT-Realtime-2（OpenAI，2025）、Gemini 3.1 Flash live（Gemini，2026）和 Gemini 3.8 Live（Google，2026c）；以及（3）决策模型，这些模型直接返回结构化决策，而非生成自由格式文本，包括 OpenAI Decisions（OpenAI，2026a）和 Jev 1.13（TypeSafe，2026）。

paragraphs.zh: 为了评估模型在真实部署环境中的性能，我们首先在所有 Wall Clock 设置下对全部 12 个智能体进行了评估。 我们报告了每次运行的通过率（定义为成功完成任务的比例），以及 pass^k 和 pass@k（其中 k ∈ {1, 2, 3}）。 遵循 τ-bench Yao et al. (2025) 的方法，pass^k 衡量的是在 k 次尝试中全部成功的概率，而 pass@k 则衡量至少有一次尝试成功的概率。

paragraphs.en: To further distinguish task performance under actual inference latency, without inference delays, and under a standardized temporal cost of token generation, we further compare Wall Clock, Paused Clock, and Token Clock on six representative models: GPT-Realtime-2, Gemini 3.1 Flash live, GPT-5.6 Sol, Claude Opus 5, Gemini 3.8 Flash, and Kimi-K3. We exclude decision models from this analysis because they do not report output token counts, which are required for Token Clock evaluation. For each clock protocol, we test both low and high reasoning effort to examine the tradeoff between decision quality and timeliness. Crossing the three clock protocols with the two reasoning levels yields six settings: WL and WH for Wall Clock, PL and PH for Paused Clock, and TL and TH for Token Clock, where L and H denote low and high reasoning effort, respectively.
paragraphs.zh: 为了进一步区分在实际推理延迟、无推理延迟以及标准化令牌生成时间成本条件下任务表现的不同，我们在六个代表性模型上进一步比较了墙钟（Wall Clock）、暂停钟（Paused Clock）和令牌钟（Token Clock）：GPT-Realtime-2、Gemini 3.1 Flash live、GPT-5.6 Sol、Claude Opus 5、Gemini 3.8 Flash 和 Kimi-K3。 我们将决策模型排除在此分析之外，因为它们没有报告输出令牌数量，而这是进行令牌钟评估所必需的数据。 对于每种时钟协议，我们都测试了低推理负荷和高推理负荷两种情况，以考察决策质量与及时性之间的权衡关系。 将三种时钟协议与两种推理水平组合，可得到六种设置：墙钟的 WL 和 WH、暂停钟的 PL 和 PH，以及令牌钟的 TL 和 TH，其中 L 和 H 分别表示低推理负荷和高推理负荷。

paragraphs.en: We set the observation rate to f = 1 f=1 FPS, following the frame-sampling recipes primarily used in current training and evaluation of real-time models ( Xia et al., 2026 ; Qian et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ; Team, 2026 ) . For the main experiments of Token Clock, we set B = 64 B=64 , corresponding to κ = B ​ f = 64 \kappa=Bf=64 charged tokens per simulated second, a rate broadly consistent with practical autoregressive decoding speed ( Yang et al., 2026 ; Team, 2025 ) , which also suffice to produce a complete action together with one or two sentences of reasoning within one observation interval based on our pilot experiment. This provides room for brief deliberation that can support successful task execution, while longer reasoning can incur a temporal cost.

paragraphs.en: As shown in Figure 1 , GPT-6 Astra (high) achieves the highest Pass^3 under Wall Clock at only 36%, indicating that even the strongest evaluated model struggles to complete tasks consistently. paragraphs.en: As shown in Figure 5 , with the environment paused during inference, Claude Opus 5 and Gemini 3.8 Flash each complete 70.0% of tasks in PH. At the same high reasoning effort, their success rates fall to 14.0% and 32.0% in WH, respectively. This decline reflects the difficulty of completing tasks when the environment advances during actual inference and serving. To examine performance independently of physical serving speed, we turn to Token Clock, which assigns a standardized temporal cost to generation. Success remains substantially below Paused Clock at 30.0% for Claude and 34.0% for Gemini in TH. The gap therefore persists when action delay is determined by token consumption rather than actual serving latency. Together, these comparisons highlight a central challenge of real-time capability: sustaining effective interaction when deliberation consumes time and the environment continues to evolve.

paragraphs.en: In Paused Clock, higher reasoning effort improves success for all six models. GPT-5.6 Sol rises from 42.0% in PL to 58.0% in PH, and Claude Opus 5 from 62.0% to 70.0%. However, the effect reverses under Token Clock for Claude, with success falling from 44.0% in TL to 30.0% in TH. Kimi-K3 instead improves from 24.0% to 36.0% under the same clock. Wall Clock shows similarly mixed effects: GPT-5.6 Sol drops from 16.0% in WL to 8.0% in WH, whereas Gemini 3.8 Flash improves from 24.0% to 32.0%. These contrasting outcomes illustrate the trade-off that adaptive deliberation must manage: further reasoning may improve action selection, but its temporal cost can reduce the opportunity to execute that action successfully.

paragraphs.en: To examine the role of this temporal cost, we hold reasoning effort at low and vary B ∈ { 32 , 64 , 128 , unlimited } B\in\{32,64,128,\mathrm{unlimited}\} at a fixed observation rate (Figure 6 ). For a fixed token count, a larger B B shortens the simulated delay before an action is applied. The setting of unlimited B corresponds to PL and assigns no simulated time to generation. paragraphs.en: Our results highlight a trade-off between the potential benefits of further reasoning and the delay it introduces. In an evolving environment, additional deliberation may improve a decision while leaving insufficient time to execute it effectively. Adaptive reasoning should therefore account for the time available to act, alongside task difficulty ( Anthropic, 2026c ; Wu et al., 2026 ) . In Tetris, for example, a model may spend more time comparing placements while a falling piece is far above the stack. As the piece approaches the stack, however, it must shorten deliberation to leave enough time to execute the required moves. The appropriate reasoning effort thus changes with the environment, even within the same task. Future work should train models to recognize these changing temporal constraints and allocate deliberation by weighing the expected benefit of further computation against the risk of acting too late.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的研究结果凸显了进一步推理可能带来的益处与其造成的延迟之间的权衡关系。 在不断变化的环境中，额外的审慎思考或许能改善决策，但却可能没有足够的时间来有效执行该决策。 因此，适应性推理应当同时考虑可用行动时间和任务难度（Anthropic, 2026c；Wu et al., 2026）。 例如，在《俄罗斯方块》中，当下落方块距离积木堆还很远时，模型可能会花更多时间比较不同的放置位置。 然而，随着方块逐渐接近积木堆，模型必须缩短思考时间，以便为执行必要操作留出足够的时间。 因此，适当的推理努力程度会随环境变化而调整，即便是在同一任务中也是如此。 未来的研究应当训练模型识别这些不断变化的时间约束，并通过权衡进一步计算的预期收益与行动过晚的风险，来分配审慎思考的资源。

sents.zh: 因此，适应性推理应当同时考虑可用行动时间和任务难度（Anthropic, 2026c；Wu et al., 2026）。

sents.en: In Tetris, for example, a model may spend more time comparing placements while a falling piece is far above the stack.
sents.zh: 例如，在《俄罗斯方块》中，当下落方块距离积木堆还很远时，模型可能会花更多时间比较不同的放置位置。

sents.en: As the piece approaches the stack, however, it must shorten deliberation to leave enough time to execute the required moves.
sents.zh: 然而，随着方块逐渐接近积木堆，模型必须缩短思考时间，以便为执行必要操作留出足够的时间。

sents.en: The appropriate reasoning effort thus changes with the environment, even within the same task.
sents.zh: 因此，适当的推理努力程度会随环境变化而调整，即便是在同一任务中也是如此。

sents.en: Future work should train models to recognize these changing temporal constraints and allocate deliberation by weighing the expected benefit of further computation against the risk of acting too late.
sents.zh: 未来的研究应当训练模型识别这些不断变化的时间约束，并通过权衡进一步计算的预期收益与行动过晚的风险，来分配审慎思考的资源。

paragraphs.en: Adapting deliberation also depends on receiving timely observations and updating actions as the environment changes. At the 1 FPS observation rate used in our experiments, brief events or rapid changes may occur between observations, even when inference itself incurs no temporal cost. For example, an enemy may change direction between two frames, preventing the agent from adjusting its action until the next observation. Higher observation rates could provide more timely feedback, but realizing this benefit requires models and harnesses that can process incoming information and revise actions with sufficiently low latency.
paragraphs.zh: 适应性决策还取决于能否及时获取观察结果，并根据环境变化更新行动。 在我们实验中使用的 1 FPS 观察频率下，即使推理本身不产生时间成本，两次观察之间也可能发生短暂事件或快速变化。 例如，敌人在两帧之间可能会改变方向，导致智能体无法调整行动，直到下一次观察。 更高的观察频率可以提供更及时的反馈，但要实现这一优势，需要模型和系统能够以足够低的延迟处理输入信息并修正行动。

paragraphs.en: (1) Model design. Higher temporal resolution presents two coupled challenges: processing more frames increases inference cost, while compressing visual inputs risks discarding brief changes that determine the next action. Addressing these challenges requires optimizing both (1) processing efficiency, for example by replacing cascaded architectures with an end-to-end single Transformer using block-causal attention ( Huang et al., 2026 ) , and (2) the preservation of action-relevant information through compact temporal representations ( Ding et al., 2025 ) or codec-aware visual encoding ( Sarkar et al., 2026 ) . Future work should explore these two directions to support higher frame rates with lower latency while preserving important information.
paragraphs.zh: 模型设计。 更高的时间分辨率带来了两个相互关联的挑战：处理更多帧会增加推理成本，而压缩视觉输入则可能丢失决定下一步动作的短暂变化。 要解决这些挑战，需要在两个方面进行优化：（1）提升处理效率，例如用采用块因果注意力的端到端单一 Transformer 取代级联架构（Huang 等，2026）；以及（2）通过紧凑的时间表示（Ding 等，2025）或考虑编解码器的视觉编码（Sarkar 等，2026）来保留与动作相关的信息。 未来的工作应探索这两个方向，以在保持重要信息的同时，支持更高的帧率并降低延迟。

paragraphs.en: (2) Interaction harnesses. Real-time harnesses must manage context and memory while coordinating observations and actions in a continuously changing environment. At higher frame rates, context sizes can rapidly exceed their budgets, and ongoing inference may become stale as new observations arrive. First, effective history representations or retrieval methods are required to manage context while preserving temporal information ( Zeng et al., 2025 ) , keeping inputs within the context budget without sacrificing critical details. Second, robust strategies are needed to address observation backlogs caused by inference delays, which can render planned actions obsolete before execution. These strategies must determine how many frames to retain, whether to employ FIFO or alternative buffer-management policies ( Yates et al., 2021 ; Li et al., 2020 ) , and how to dynamically decide whether to discard or revise planned actions as inference becomes stale ( Black et al., 2025 ) . Future work should explore these directions to make real-time systems more robust and efficient.

paragraphs.en: We introduced Realtime-Bench, a suite of diverse dynamic game and web tasks for evaluating real-time interactive capability in multimodal agents. Our evaluation of 12 frontier models shows that real-time interaction remains challenging: under Wall Clock, the best success rate reaches only 44.0%, and the best Pass^3 is only 36%. To disentangle the effects of serving latency and models’ real-time streaming capability, we compared three clock protocols, introducing Token Clock to preserve the temporal cost of deliberation independently of physical serving speed. Substantial gaps relative to Paused Clock persist under Token Clock, highlighting the difficulty of translating task competence into timely action. Across the six models analyzed under different reasoning efforts, higher effort improves success under Paused Clock but has mixed effects under temporal pressure. Relaxing the temporal cost of generation generally improves performance but does not ensure success. These findings motivate adaptive reasoning with temporal awareness and continuous perception and action, allowing agents to coordinate deliberation and execution with the time available. Realtime-Bench provides a controlled setting for studying these capabilities and measuring progress toward effective real-time interaction.
paragraphs.zh: 我们推出了 Realtime-Bench，这是一套包含多样化动态游戏和网页任务的测试集，用于评估多模态智能体的实时交互能力。 我们对 12 款前沿模型进行的评估表明，实时交互仍然充满挑战：在“墙钟”协议下，最佳成功率仅为 44.0%，而最佳 Pass^3 成绩也仅有 36%。 为了区分服务延迟与模型实时流式处理能力的各自影响，我们对比了三种时钟协议，并引入了“令牌钟”协议，以独立于实际服务速度地保留推理过程的时间成本。 即使在“令牌钟”协议下，与“暂停钟”协议相比仍存在显著差距，这凸显了将任务能力转化为及时行动的难度。 在六种不同推理强度下的模型中，更高的推理强度虽能提升“暂停钟”协议下的成功率，但在时间压力下效果则参差不齐。 降低生成过程的时间成本通常能提升性能，但并不能保证成功。 这些发现推动了具备时间感知能力的自适应推理以及持续感知与行动机制的发展，使智能体能够根据可用时间协调推理与执行。 Realtime-Bench 提供了一个受控环境，可用于研究这些能力，并衡量向有效实时交互迈进的进展。

paragraphs.en: Streaming models maintain the retained history within their sessions, while asynchronous models resubmit the retained context. To maximize cache reuse and reduce inference latency, we preserve the order and content of retained messages and remove older history only in blocks when the retention limits are exceeded. This keeps the shared context prefix stable across consecutive decisions, allowing models to reuse cached computation where supported. Both mechanisms implement the same logical history policy.

paragraphs.en: We access Jev 1.13 and OpenAI Decisions through OpenRouter API. For these models, the harness constructs candidate GUI actions from the current observation and submits them as a choice question. Text entry can be composed through successive choices before executing a single typing action. Jev 1.13 does not natively support screenshot inputs. We therefore represent its Web observations as structured text using the browser accessibility tree (AX tree), interactable elements, and appearance descriptors. This representation does not adequately capture the visual state of our game tasks, so we evaluate Jev 1.13 only on Web tasks. OpenAI Decisions additionally receives screenshots. Both models are evaluated only under the wall-clock setting.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过 OpenRouter API 访问 Jev 1.13 和 OpenAI Decisions。 对于这些模型，工具会根据当前观察结果构建候选的 GUI 操作，并将其作为选择题提交。 文本输入可以通过连续的选择来组成，之后执行一次打字操作。 Jev 1.13 本身不支持截图输入。 因此，我们使用浏览器的无障碍树（AX 树）、可交互元素和外观描述符，将它的 Web 观察结果表示为结构化文本。 这种表示方式无法充分捕捉我们游戏任务的视觉状态，因此我们仅对 Jev 1.13 的 Web 任务进行评估。 OpenAI Decisions 还会接收截图。 这两个模型都仅在实时时钟设置下进行评估。

paragraphs.en: By inspecting failed trajectories, the first author identified three failure modes and developed an annotation codebook specifying operational definitions, inclusion criteria, and exclusion rules. For lack of temporal awareness (RT-Deliberate), we annotated failures under TL and TH to examine whether models accounted for the temporal cost of deliberation under standardized token-based timing; Paused Clock removes this cost, whereas Wall Clock additionally reflects deployment-dependent latency. For failure to track the evolving state (RT-Perceive) and misjudging whether action is needed (RT-Act), we annotated failures under PH, which pauses the environment during generation and uses high reasoning effort, allowing us to examine state tracking and action necessity judgments without environment changes during inference. We then prompted Codex to apply the codebook to the recorded action trajectories, timing information, available model reasoning, and observations. All failed trajectories in the selected conditions were screened, with targeted inspection of video frames to verify candidate events rather than exhaustive frame-by-frame review. The second author checked the resulting annotations against the source evidence.
paragraphs.zh: 通过检查失败的轨迹，第一作者识别出三种失败模式，并制定了一份标注代码手册，其中明确了操作定义、纳入标准和排除规则。 由于缺乏时间感知能力（RT-Deliberate），我们在 TL 和 TH 条件下对失败进行了标注，以检验模型是否在标准化的基于标记的计时机制下考虑了深思熟虑所带来的时间成本；Paused Clock 消除了这一成本，而 Wall Clock 则额外反映了部署相关的延迟。 针对未能跟踪状态变化（RT-Perceive）以及错误判断是否需要采取行动（RT-Act）的情况，我们在 PH 条件下对失败进行了标注。该条件在生成过程中暂停环境并使用高推理强度，使我们能够在推理期间不改变环境的情况下，检验状态跟踪和行动必要性判断的能力。 随后，我们提示 Codex 将代码手册应用于记录的动作轨迹、时间信息、模型可用的推理过程以及观察结果。 我们对所选条件下所有失败的轨迹进行了筛选，并通过有针对性地检查视频帧来验证候选事件，而非进行逐帧的全面审查。 第二作者将最终的标注结果与原始证据进行了核对。

paragraphs.en: Figures 12 – 16 show examples from Wall Clock runs, in which the environment keeps running while the model infers. paragraphs.en: Prompt D.1.2 specifies the GUI actions, how to use the SoM marks or screenshot coordinates to select an action’s location, and the required output format. For each episode, we combine these shared instructions with three components. The domain instruction identifies the environment as a game or a web task and specifies how the agent should interact with it, defined in Appendix D.1.1 . The clock instruction explains the clock protocols, specified in Appendix D.1.2 . The task instruction states the specific objective and requirements for the current task, corresponding to the success criteria.

paragraphs.zh: 令牌时钟（提示 D.1.2）：计费的输出令牌决定了观察与行动之间的模拟延迟。

paragraphs.en: Paused environment (Prompt D.1.2 ): output length does not advance simulated time; each action is applied at the observed tick before the environment advances one frame interval.
paragraphs.zh: 暂停的环境（提示 D.1.2）：输出长度不会推进模拟时间；每次操作都在环境推进一个帧间隔之前，于当前观察到的时间步执行。

paragraphs.en: Wall clock (Prompt D.1.2 ): environment time follows physical elapsed time.
paragraphs.zh: 挂钟（提示 D.1.2）：环境时间遵循物理流逝时间。
